claims.head: The Jets want Scheifele away from the big guns
claims.call: The Jets’ L1 (Scheifele, Connor and Perfetti) spends at least 38% of its 5-on-5 time against the Wild’s third line.
claims.body: At home, the Jets keep sending Scheifele’s line (Scheifele, Connor and Perfetti) out against opponents’ third lines, far more often than chance would. That’s Scott Arniel chasing an easier matchup for the team’s scorers. Tonight the Wild’s third line is McCarron, Trenin and Sturm.
claims.nums: At home: 38% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against third lines, about 26% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Scott Arniel likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Wild’s third line.

check.measure: share of Winnipeg L1's 5-on-5 time against Minnesota L3
check.rule: held if the share is at or above the home habit; partly if above the no-matching level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: In close against from distance
claims.body: The Wild are one of the league’s best for shots from in close, at the close-range end; the Jets are near the bottom of the league, at the long-range end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.nums: Shots from in close: Minnesota 5th, Winnipeg 27th
claims.gist: The Wild and the Jets sit at opposite ends for shots from in close.
claims.call: The Wild take a bigger share of their shots from within 20 feet than the Jets.
